versions.changelog:
- Initial release of openclaw-memory-auto: automatic memory archiving for OpenClaw.
- Archives daily chat highlights using language-agnostic, customizable keywords.
- Works out of the box; supports configuration for keywords, paths, and schedule.
- Cross-platform, zero-setup, and compatible with multiple agents.
- Optional AI refinement updates MEMORY.md with structured summaries.
- Non-intrusive: runs on startup or cron, respecting user privacy by archiving only key messages.
